name: Combbit · Gremlet #42
description:
One cell of honeycomb that escaped the hive. Always a little sticky, always very sweet.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Combbit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
